idea-plugin.description:
Table Structure Viewer adds read-only table and view structure tabs and a schema-based object browser to DataGrip.

The plugin UI is currently in Simplified Chinese.

Features

  • Inspect columns, data types, default values, comments, indexes, primary and unique keys, and foreign keys.
  • Browse tables, views, sequences, and stored routines by schema, with name search and object-type filters.
  • Open table or view structures with a left-button double-click. Copy cells or rows as tab-separated text.
  • For tables, open DataGrip's native Modify Table dialog, data editor, or generated CREATE SQL in a SQL console.
  • Preview and copy Oracle ADD COLUMN statements and column comments for selected columns.

Usage and requirements

In the Database tool window, right-click a table or view and select “查看表结构” (View Table Structure). Select “对象总览” (Object Overview) to browse a data source by schema.

Requires DataGrip with Database Tools and SQL. Built and binary-compatibility checked against DataGrip 2026.2.6 (build 262). Other IDE releases and database dialects have not been comprehensively tested.

Structure data comes from DataGrip's introspected model. If objects are missing, check the selected schema, permissions, and introspection settings, refresh the data source in DataGrip, and then reload the overview.

The selected-column DDL preview always uses Oracle syntax; it does not adapt to other database dialects. Identity, computed, and untyped columns are skipped with an explanatory SQL comment. Generated SQL is not executed automatically. The native table tools can modify data or structure when you apply changes there. Custom structure and overview tabs are not restored after an IDE restart.

中文介绍

Table Structure Viewer 为 DataGrip 提供表和视图的只读结构标签页，以及按 schema 浏览数据库对象的总览。当前插件界面为简体中文。

  • 查看列、数据类型、默认值、注释、索引、主键、唯一约束和外键。
  • 按 schema 浏览表、视图、序列和存储过程，支持名称搜索和对象类型过滤。
  • 快速左键双击表或视图打开结构；支持复制单元格，以及按制表符分隔复制整行。
  • 为表提供 DataGrip 原生修改表对话框、数据编辑器和创建 SQL 控制台的快捷入口。
  • 预览和复制选中列的 Oracle 新增列语句及列注释。

在 Database 工具窗口右键选择“查看表结构”或“对象总览”即可使用。依赖 Database Tools and SQL， 已针对 DataGrip 2026.2.6（build 262）完成构建和二进制兼容性检查；其他 IDE 版本及数据库方言尚未全面验证。

结构信息来自 DataGrip 已内省的模型。若缺少对象，请检查 schema、权限和内省设置，先在 DataGrip 刷新数据源，再刷新对象总览。

选中列的 DDL 预览始终使用 Oracle 语法，不会自动适配其他数据库；自增列、计算列及缺少类型的列会跳过并附加说明。 生成的 SQL 不会自动执行；在原生表操作工具中应用修改可能更改数据或结构。结构和总览标签页暂不支持 IDE 重启后恢复。

idea-plugin.change-notes:
1.0.0

  • Read-only table and view structure tabs with cell and row copying.
  • A schema-based object browser with search, type filters, and native table actions.
  • Oracle selected-column DDL previews and native CREATE SQL generation. UI in Simplified Chinese.

中文：提供表和视图结构标签页、单元格与整行复制、按 schema 浏览和筛选对象、 DataGrip 原生表操作，以及 Oracle 选中列 DDL 预览。当前界面为简体中文。
